course_name: 外語群/英語文專長教材教法
outline: This course is designed as an intensive teacher training program for students to become effective EFL teachers. Students are required to do the microteaching and present some selected chapters from the textbooks.
schedule:
Week 1  Course Introduction
Week 2  Approaches to ELT
Week 3  No class
Week 4  Competency-based Instruction
Week 5  No class
Week 6  Integrating Issues in ELT
Week 7  Classroom Observation
Week 8  Lesson Planning
Week 9  International Education
Week 10	English Remedial Instruction
Week 11	AI-assisted Language Teaching
Week 12	Language Education and Bilingual Policies
Week 13	Cross-disciplinary Instruction
Week 14	Teaching Demonstration
Week 15	Final Exam
Week 16	No class
Weeks17-18 Tutorial & Self-directed Learning

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)

assessment:
Selected chapters presentation and assignments: 30%
Teaching demonstration & lesson plan: 30%
Classroom Observation Reports: 10%
Learning report: 10%
Attendance & participation: 20%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：否

中學英語文教材教法(教育部-總策劃;葉錫南-主編)，五南書局出版。
extended_resources: 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
ai_usage: 鼓勵學生使用生成式AI工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
